name: hands-connector
description: Elaya's hands: the second WhatsApp number (migration 0245). Sends ONLY what hands.outbox holds, ONLY to hands.allowed_contacts. A separate process from the Sia watcher.

scripts.start: trap 'echo; echo [hands] stopped; exit 0' INT TERM; while true; do tsx src/index.ts; echo '[hands] restarting in 2s (crash-only)'; sleep 2; done
